missions.title: Stinger
missions.description: "The Bee Sting. It goes everywhere."

missions.title: Black Box
missions.description: "I'm here to ensure your loyalty—or should I say, to instill some loyalty in you.

missions.title: Secret Watch
missions.description: "To sketch a mountain, one must stand on the plains; and to sketch a plain, one must stand on a mountain."

missions.title: Pursuit I
missions.description: "Heroes from all over the world are heading toward Berlin on the Argo, all seeking the evil Golden Fleece."

missions.title: Nike I
missions.description: "Everything has changed since Unity Day. Those who cannot keep up are destined to drown in the waves."

missions.title: "Dead Sea"
missions.description: "It is now a land of death and decay that even birds cannot fly across. We call it 'Avernus'."

missions.title: Flutter
missions.description: "Before we turn our eyes to our external enemies, we must first take care of the opportunists within our ranks."

missions.title: Wheelrut
missions.description: "We need a stiletto to thrust into the heart of the enemy... but it should preferably be wielded by someone else."

missions.title: Lurking II
missions.description: "Given my status, completing this mission implies that the Griffin Base will come under the General's protection."

missions.title: Vortex
missions.description: "If the Dead Sea is the entrance to Hell, then we are Aeneas, the one who descended into the Underworld."

missions.title: Gardener
missions.description: "To friendship."

missions.title: Commencement
missions.description: "Right now, we are an unexpected dagger to the enemy's heart."

missions.title: Against the Light I
missions.description: "I don't seek to be understood. I don't seek forgiveness either."

missions.title: Intersection Point I
missions.description: "All the lines, all the points, they all exist for this..."

missions.title: Strongarm
missions.description: "I've brought you two trump cards. One is me, and the other is this."

missions.title: Fissure
missions.description: "I won't abandon anyone. At least, not until I have to."

missions.title: Blood Moon II
missions.description: "Most reunions are very touching, but there are always exceptions."

missions.title: Reflection
missions.description: "The faint moonlight leaks out from between the two towers. Not even birds flying in the air would be visible against this light."

missions.title: Open the Way
missions.description: "She has tried to save the world all this while, and now it is time for us to save her."

missions.title: Elevation
missions.description: "Friends don't always stay friends, and the same goes for enemies."

missions.title: Ascent
missions.description: "Through me you pass into the city of woe, through me you pass into eternal pain, through me among the people lost for aye."

missions.title: Incursion
missions.description: "At the Gate of Hell, the bird has its wings broken."

missions.title: Old Rain II
missions.description: "Right now, it feels as if she'd returned to that old mansion, but this time, both her arms are intact and her primary weapon is fully loaded."

missions.title: Lonely Island II
missions.description: "Everything is possible. Never say never."

missions.title: Traitor II
missions.description: "We've all seen hell worse than this. As if I'd let you stop me."

missions.title: Solution
missions.description: "I knew it all along. In the end, we really are allies, Commander."

missions.title: Endpoint
missions.description: "Before me, were those who walked the same path, and there will definitely be others after me."

missions.title: Deduction I
missions.description: "It's time we let the other Dolls try to fight Paradeus without help."

missions.title: Deduction II
missions.description: "It seems a bit too early, but we should still offer her some help."

missions.title: Deduction III
missions.description: "You have learned how to deal with Paradeus. Now, annihilate them!"

missions.title: Deduction IV
missions.description: "Show them what we Griffin Dolls are made of!"
